working_title: Measurement Freshness and State Reconstruction for Wind-Power Shortfall Decisions: A Controlled SCADA Evaluation
main_question: After historical SCADA and a common wind-power forecast commitment are available, which shortfall consequences change when measurements are refreshed, states are reconstructed, or state scores are added?
article_identity: Retrospective empirical evaluation of two completed controlled development studies; not a new method, globally novel principle or confirmatory synthesis

core_contributions.claim: Current-power and current-pitch update packages have different proxy-cost outcomes under the evaluated procedures
core_contributions.limit: No pure information ordering, universal replacement, confirmed interaction or safety substitution

core_contributions.claim: Direct histories, a recovered pitch score and a compressed decision-head input have distinct attainable outcomes; score-specific semantics are not isolated
core_contributions.limit: No global state uselessness, causal mediation or end-to-end data compression

core_contributions.claim: Calibration, procurement, uncovered shortfall and strict event frequency give different assessments of the tested programs
core_contributions.limit: No equal-budget or pitch-exclusive allocation advantage; MLP uncertainty and original route failures retained

literature.existing_user_ml_wind_pdf: MLWA2026 formal15-page article; selected key sections rechecked after prior full reading
not_claimed_first: latent state or extra measurement comparison

evidence_separation.Towie2025: SI original frozen fixed-reference and separate secondary-family question only; not confirmation of the new measurement/reconstruction narrative

four_questions.why_care: Choices between measurement refresh and state recoding require direct consequence evidence, beyond recovery metrics
four_questions.whats_new: Specific wind-SCADA comparison outcomes and boundaries after direct histories, rather than invention of the general principles
four_questions.why_believe: Study-internal common targets/populations, original frozen procedures and stored paired intervals, controls and adverse endpoints retained
four_questions.why_this_venue: Wind forecasting, telemetry and operating-state interpretation readers obtain a concrete empirical comparison beyond the V2 column-width trade; significance remains an editorial judgement

exploratory_only: near-zero event interpretation beyond stored diagnostics
calibration or estimator-specific explanation not causally isolated
stop_plan_if: requires deleting MLP adverse risk or original route failures
requires pooling distinct study populations or inference families
requires treating unresolved semantic or budget attribution as established
specific empirical differences disappear and only a generic quality-value slogan remains
stronger_claims_blocked_by_missing_evide: cross-site or new-year confirmation of this new question
realised telemetry savings or actual reserve deliverability
disclosure: Role-separated internal literature/evidence/adversarial review, not blind or independent error processes; plan judgement is not a journal decision.
